questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the option that correctly reports the statement: 'I haven't seen him for years.'
options: He said he hadn't seen me for years.
He said he hadn't seen him for years.
He said he hadn't seen them for years.
He said he hadn't seen it for years.
questions.answer: He said he hadn't seen him for years.

He said if he had known about the party, he would attend.
He said if he had known about the party, he would attend it.
He said if he had known about the party, he would have attended it.
questions.answer: He said if he had known about the party, he would have attended it.
